item.title: This Day In Dodgers History: Jackie Robinson Voted Into Baseball Hall Of Fame
item.description: On Jan. 23, 1962, the Baseball Writers’ Association of America (BBWAA) voted Brooklyn Dodgers legend Jackie Robinson into the National Baseball Hall of Fame. Robinson received 77.5% (124 of 160) of all the ballots cast, earning him enshrinement in his first year of eligibility. Cleveland Indians great Bob Feller (93.8%) was also voted in, marking […]
